VIDiff deploy now validates artifact metadata against trusted workflow_run lineage, resolves missing pull-request association from the commit-to-PR API, blocks Pages publication for fork PR artifacts (comment/status fall back to Actions artifact or run links), preserves workflow_dispatch historical target SHAs only when both the producer head and target SHA are reachable from default-branch history and the producer head repository is trusted, and extracts report ZIPs with path-safe checks that reject absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink entries before deploy/status/comment updates.
